text:
Taylor: Quick heads-up — planning a controlled toggle for the `per-tenant-routing` feature flag tomorrow at 07:30am PT. Goal is a 10% canary for 30m, then 50% for 20m if metrics look good, then full lift. I can flip if someone owns smoke checks and rollback.

Miguel: I can take the canary flip at 07:30, pinging for owners for smoke. What's the exact metrics threshold we want to watch?

Taylor: Good q. Primary checks: p50 latency <= 120ms, error rate spike < 0.5% over baseline, CPU on inference nodes < 75%. If any of those break, rollback immediately. Also watch cost per token; if it jumps 20% it's worth pausing.

Aisha: I'll own smoke tests and dashboard watch for the first 30m. I'll run the standard smoke script and validate sample responses for 5 tenants.

Kelly: I can be on-call for rollback. Miguel, if you flip and Aisha flags something, tag me and I'll run the rollback command.

Miguel: Sounds good. For canary traffic split, do we route by tenant-id prefix or random sampling? Prefer prefix so we can target internal tenants.

Taylor: Prefix sampling — use tenant IDs starting with `int-` for initial canary. We'll only include our internal tenants. Update the toggle config to include `int-` whitelist.

Aisha: I'll run these smoke steps after flip and paste results here.

Aisha: Smoke checklist (I'll paste results after run):
```
1) curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"tenant":"int-001","prompt":"short"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
2) run ./scripts/smoke/validate_responses.sh int-001 int-002 int-003
3) check dashboards: inference.latency.p50, inference.errors.per_min, node.cpu.utilization
4) confirm no more than 3% drop in success ratio for those tenants
```

Taylor: Rollback command (Kelly, paste to run if we need):
```
# run from infractl box
infractl flags update per-tenant-routing --set-mode=off --note "rollback - smoke fail" --actor=@kelly
```

deploy-bot: Deploy window created: 2026-03-20T07:30:00-07:00 (PT). Owner: Miguel. Reminders: 07:15 sanity ping, 07:35 first-check results.

Miguel: I'll do a 07:15 pre-check to confirm infra is green. If anything looks off I'll delay +30m and notify here.

Taylor: Thanks — final ask: Miguel flip + initial canary, Aisha runs smoke and posts PASS/FAIL summary, Kelly stands by for rollback. If all green after 50% window, I'll lift to full. :thumbsup:

Kelly: Ond it. Will be available 07:25-08:30 PT.

Aisha: I'll post PASS within 10m of flip or FAIL with logs.

Miguel: OK locking in schedule. See you all tomorrow morning. :coffee:
